failure_mode.returns_on_failure: A true absence returns KeyCount=0 at rc=0 -- a failed retrieval returns a VALUE, not an error. And a --query PROJECTION can render `None` where the field is 0
failure_mode.evidence: FOUR read-only probe classes, each a SEPARATE invocation, rc read UNPIPED. MEASURED: (1) true absence -> rc=0 out='0'; (2) wrong bucket -> rc=255 out='An error occurred (NoSuchBucket) when calling the ListObject', an ERROR not a zero; (3) wrong region -> rc=0 out='1'; (4) near-miss prefix, this home's own uuid tail mutated -> rc=0 out='0'. ⛔ THE FIFTH CLASS -- a missing s3:ListBucket -- WAS NOT EXERCISED and may also return a zero; that unexercised class is the SOLE ground on which distinguishable_from_true_negative is `no` at basis `inferred`. ⭐ AND A FIFTH RENDERING CLASS, EXECUTED AT BUILD TIME RATHER THAN NARRATED, on the pending prefix -- AND THE COMPARISON IS BETWEEN TWO ARGUMENT SETS, WHICH THIS CARD NOW SAYS. WITH --max-keys: projection -> '0', full response carries KeyCount -> True. WITHOUT --max-keys: projection -> 'None', full response carries KeyCount -> False. So `None` renders a MISSING FIELD, not a real zero: it is the auto-pagination shape, the same family as the documented trap that --query length() over a paginated list-* returns the PAGE count. ⛔ AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS CARD claimed the full response carried KeyCount 0 while its own projection rendered None, and called a differently-argumented call an identical control. FALSE AS WRITTEN, and hardcoded prose rather than an executed probe. 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X caught both halves. The queue IS empty -- under --max-keys, the shape that can express a zero at all.

verdict.why: A REGISTERED, NAMED SURFACE that stopped: the P1 member of the snap family, declared in its writer's own SURFACES registry, whose SURVIVING objects were written by two appends on consecutive days with no later surviving write and 44 days of staleness at carding. Unlike this face's cse_test cards it is not a scratch table -- the writer names it -- which is why its methodology row is `measured` rather than `inferred`. QUALIFIED, and these are the qualifications: `authority_role` is `projection` taken from the writer's DECLARED design and not from any measured row correspondence, because the projected Trino surface was not read; coverage spans the OBJECT plane plus one heartbeat key and NO row was read at either; the catalog binding is HELD, since name-uniqueness in the measured set is not a verified catalog resolution; the failure mode is not distinguishable from a true negative on the one unexercised permission class; the cadence row attributes NO rhythm to the writer, which declares a dated sibling and an identity partition key and neither is a cadence; the trigger absence is measured on the two CLOUD planes only, not on a host-bound one; and WHY the writes stopped after two days is UNMEASURED. ⛔ THIS CARD DOES NOT CLASSIFY THE STOP AS A DEFECT. A dated snapshot sibling that ran twice may have been exercised exactly as intended, and this seat measured the planes rather than the intent. Naming the state is the carder's job; deciding it is the owner's.
